note: These are FEATHERS of a steel eagle, made of faceted mint crystal, NOT leaves: every feather is long and narrow with a straight central quill (shaft) running its full length, the vane split into a few angular crystal facets with sharp straight edges and a squared or notched tip like a flight feather; never a leaf shape, never leaf veins, never a stem. Silver parts are flat light grey. Nothing in the sheet should look like a plant.
